cells.gaps: No named sanction, decision or published count of settled cases is reported under the law; EGY-004 and EGY-006 report guidelines, frameworks and templates only. Sources describe a compliance grace period to 31 October or 1 November 2026 (EGY-001, EGY-009, EGY-014, EGY-015); EGY-015 dates the law's entry into force to October 2020, so standing is read as in force with the grace period noted.
cells.note: Standing is in-force and regulations are issued, but application is activity (guidelines and a licensing portal, no decision), so stage 4 is not met. Authority is constituted (acting head Nov 2025, portal live Oct 2026), so no cap applies.
